Logan / Ben / Samantha — reviewed the attachments and drafted a compromise path below. High level: Redwood will accept defend-and-indemnify for third-party IP claims that directly allege infringement by Redwood's hosted service or the specific model weights we serve (i.e., claims tied to Redwood-managed assets). We will not accept indemnity for: (a) OSS components (we'll provide OSS list and carveouts), (b) customer-supplied content/prompts, or (c) downstream customer outputs that claim patent overlap absent proof linking to Redwood-delivered model artifacts.

Proposed commercial/legal terms (draft language to follow):
- Scope: Redwood will indemnify and defend Bridgestone from third-party claims alleging direct copyright or patent infringement to the extent caused by Redwood's service/model.
- Defense control: Redwood has the right to assume and manage the defense; Bridgestone may participate and may take over defense at its own cost if Redwood elects not to defend within 30 days of notice.
- Cap: Liability limited to the lesser of (i) fees paid by Bridgestone to Redwood in the 12 months prior to the claim and (ii) $4,000,000.
- Insurance/escrow: If Bridgestone requires, we can discuss an escrow or specified insurance endorsement; we'd prefer an insurance approach for large enterprises.
- OSS / training-data carveouts: explicit exclusions for known OSS components and claims traceable to customer input or third-party datasets. We'll deliver an OSS list and model provenance notes under NDA if needed.
- Prompt notice/cooperation/timely evidence: standard notice/cure/cooperation steps; failure to notify timely may limit Redwood's obligations.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Ben to confirm whether the proposed $4M cap is commercially acceptable or whether Bridgestone requires a lower fixed cap tied to revenue.
2) Logan to offer Bridgestone a 30-min legal sync next week to resolve defense-control language and OSS carveouts.
3) I will prepare draft redline language for insertion into the order form (ETA: Mon EOD our side).

Neha Kapoor
